answer: No — this is not just an older‑customer habit. Multiple complaints and a trend show real usability issues: hybrid batteries reducing usable boot, missing electric/open‑close features and internal shut buttons, and unreliable tailgates; an EU study also reports low luggage capacity. These are recurring, cross‑source signals, not isolated nostalgia.
suggested_change: Make an interior shut button and at least two luggage tie‑down anchor points mandatory; require EV/hybrid variants to publish VDA‑measured usable boot volume versus the 380 L target and provide customer‑impact justification if they fall below it.
